specification.gate: Every timing arm meets independent original-world accuracy; exact complete payload parity across timing arms and separately allocation arms after removing only explicit new storage/budget metadata; three alternating complete-call-plus-JSON pairs, median candidate time no worse and each pair <=1.05x baseline; separate 10-sweep Python-traced peak at least 20% lower. Short-arm target misses retained. One fixed experiment, no post-hoc retries.
specification.scope: Same verified four-hand-per-seat/four-flop conditioned preflop/flop betting game and forced future checkdown; original private indexing only. Full original-world and additional streaming budgets enforced before ranking/groups. Standard library only; no shared kernels, later-street betting, Coach or third-party source.
specification.replay_reuse: Independently replay every distinct normalized complete-game payload once. Later arms may reuse metric-only replay evidence only for the same fixture hash and exact normalized full-payload SHA-256; posterior and production metric comparisons still run per arm. No policy objects or strings retained. All six timing payloads must additionally equal the prior verified 500/250 complete-payload hash.

timing_scope: Three alternating complete solves plus raw JSON, including construction, full requested-T training and exact diagnostics; inputs/GC precede measurement, parity normalization and original-world independent replay follow it. No prior policies retained between arms.
quality_scope: Independently replay every distinct normalized complete-game payload once. Later arms may reuse metric-only replay evidence only for the same fixture hash and exact normalized full-payload SHA-256; posterior and production metric comparisons still run per arm. No policy objects or strings retained. All six timing payloads must additionally equal the prior verified 500/250 complete-payload hash.
allocation_scope: Separate 10/delay5 complete calls plus raw JSON under tracemalloc. Python-traced allocations, not RSS or high-iteration memory. Both short-arm quality results retained.
parity_scope: Complete payload comparison after removing only top-level world_storage/world_storage_metadata and vector streamed_world_construction/reference-version, subtracting its declared extra loops and restoring the original budget version. No policy, count, posterior, utility or accuracy fields removed.
model_limits: Finite conditioned heads-up preflop/flop game with four weighted exact combos per player, four selected flops, 9,408 ordered future candidates, 91,080 compatible physical worlds, forced flop checkdown, and one shared 10-chip stack. Not full-deck preflop, turn/river betting, multiway or unrestricted NLHE; no general convergence claim.
